name: Promptbreeder
one_liner: Self-referential evolutionary algorithm that simultaneously evolves task heuristics and the mutation prompts that generate them under benchmark fitness.

loop.proposes: An LLM applies a population of evolving mutation-prompts to parent task-prompts (plus Lamarckian working-out traces) to produce offspring.
loop.judged_by: An automated benchmark harness evaluates each candidate on multi-step mathematical, logic, and commonsense training batches.
loop.steers: Binary tournament genetic selection updates both the task-prompt genome and the meta-level mutation-prompt genome.

headline_result: Outperformed Chain-of-Thought, Plan-and-Solve, and OPRO across arithmetic, commonsense, and hate-speech classification benchmarks.
caveat: Requires thousands of forward evaluation passes across the evolutionary population before convergence.
beyond_harness_note: A binary-tournament genetic algorithm controls population evolution over both task heuristics and hyper-mutation operators.
algorithmic_authority: Tournament genetic algorithm and benchmark fitness evaluator

sources.title: Promptbreeder: Self-Referential Self-Improvement Via Prompt Evolution (ICML 2024 / arXiv:2309.16797)

verification.notes: Checked against Fernando et al., ICML 2024.
